data.subject: Your FCL Quote: Rotterdam to New York, 1 x 20GP (Ceramic Tiles)
data.body:
Dear Tom de Vries,

Thank you for your quote request. Please find our offer for your shipment below.

Lane: Rotterdam -> New York
Container: 1 x 20GP
Commodity: Ceramic tiles

All-in total: EUR 2770

This all-in total includes:
- Base ocean freight: EUR 1800 per container
- BAF: EUR 320 per container
- Terminal handling Rotterdam (THC): EUR 225 per container
- Terminal handling New York (THC): EUR 290 per container
- ISPS: EUR 25 per container
- Documentation: EUR 65 per shipment
- Export customs clearance: EUR 45 per shipment

Validity: This quote is valid through 2026-12-31.

If you would like to proceed, please reply to confirm and send us your preferred cargo ready date along with the shipper and consignee details. We will then arrange the booking. If you have any questions or need a quote for other container types or volumes, please let us know.

Kind regards,

Linkport Forwarders BV
